parse.title: Western Provinces Diary
parse.wikitext:
===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 4]]:
**Depicts an [[Elf|elven]] pattern
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]]
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 70
*Two [[chompy bird]]s will always appear at once when [[chompy bird hunting]]
*Chance of receiving a [[chompy chick]] when [[chompy bird hunting]], at a rate of 1/500
*[[Rantz]] offers you 150 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|150}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*[[Nieve]]/[[Steve]] now grant as many [[slayer reward point]]s as [[Duradel]]/[[Kuradal]]
*Resurrect with full health and restored stats once per day when you reach 0 [[hitpoints]] against [[Zulrah]], allowing you to continue on with the fight (the task list of this diary will show you whether you've used this daily resurrection, and this is considered a "safe death" for [[Ironman Mode#Hardcore|Hardcore Ironman]] players)
